info: Plan C. Changes: the TV and sofas are swapped – the marble TV wall, 75" TV and console now sit on the east wall (bedroom 3 side, with an acoustic backing layer), and the L-sofa with chaise sits on the west side facing it, with the marble diptych above. Sofa users now face away from the study glass. Study by the shelter, its wall now flush with the shelter cabinet fronts, and a straight key niche at the end of the cabinet run; dining outside the kitchen. Kitchen: closed or open, open keeps the stove-side top cabinets with a ducted hood, tall units at the yard end and bi-fold glass to close it. Removing the kitchen front wall must be confirmed with HDB / your ID. Power points and trunking are indicative.
